title: Block to head
description: Paper plugin, which allows you to put blocks on your head
body:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2b5c6ac9d8cac2538ed107cd77b5fa828059378_0.webp)

This plugin allows you to put blocks on your head. By default, it has a whitelist of blocks, because most of the minecraft items on its head look ridiculous.

You can dress the block with the command `/onhead` or through the inventory.

Whitelisted blocks:

![Whitelist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3eb2a9cdaa99f0b8e0ef1c90dd4954090bf2d8f_0.webp)

You can safely disable it, change the plug-in permissions (prohibit players from putting an item on their head, and so on.)
